tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.COURSE_TYPE_SUBJECT_SC: course, semester wise subject master details. join as coursecode,semcode,subjectcode
tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.GRADE_DETAILS: This table defines grading scales for courses, where each row represents a score range band and its corresponding grade value for a specific course and session combination. The columns START_RANGE and END_RANGE define the percentage boundaries (e.g., 95-100), while GRADE_VALUE contains the numeric grade points awarded for that range, keyed by COURSECD, SESSCODE, and GRADE_ID. Use this table to look up or convert raw scores into grade values, or join to it when building reports that need to map student marks to their corresponding grades for a given course session.
tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.TRPASSOUTDATATABLE: This table stores comprehensive semester-wise academic results for passed-out students, with one row per student keyed by STUDENTCODE (or ROLL_NO/ENROLL_NO). Each row contains marks obtained (OBT_SEM1-10), total marks (TOT_SEM1-10), pass/fail results (RESULT_SEM1-10), examination periods (YEAR_SEM1-10), credits earned (CRDT_SEM1-10), and SGPA values for up to 10 semesters. Use this table when building reports on student academic performance, graduation records, or calculating cumulative scores across semesters.
tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.TRPRINTSTUDENTDETAILS: This table stores student examination results and details for printing/reporting purposes, with one row per student per course, keyed by STUDENTCODE and TRCOURSECODE. Each row contains student biographical information (STUDENTNAME, FATHERSNAME, MOTHERSNAME, STUDENTSEX), enrollment details (EXAMROLLNUMBER, COLLEGECODE, COLLEGENAME, COURSENAME), and comprehensive exam results including theory and practical marks (THEOOBT, PRACOBT, TOTAL), credit information (TRCREDIT, COURSETOTALCREDIT), and grade metrics (COURSE_SGPA, RESULT). Use this table when generating student transcripts, marksheets, or result reports, and join via STUDENTCODE for student master data or COLLEGECODE for institution details.
tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.TRPRINTSTUDENT_ROWS: This table stores detailed student transcript print rows, with one row per assessment component (unit) within a subject for a student's semester enrollment. Each row represents a specific evaluation type (e.g., THEORY or I.A. indicated by TYPE and TNAME) for a subject unit (UNIT, UNITNAME), keyed by the combination of STUDENTCODE, TRCOURSECODE, SUBJECTCODE, SEMCODE, and UNIT, and includes marks (CTOTAL, STOTAL, CMAXMARK), credits (CREDIT, CRPOINT), and pass/fail status (SRESULT). Use this table when generating student transcripts or grade reports that require line-item breakdowns of theory and internal assessment scores per subject.
tables.SUBJECTBILANG_IGU.TRROOTMASTER: This table defines the master configuration for examination result processing runs, with one row per unique tabulation register (result batch) identified by TRCOURSECODE. Each row represents a specific course-semester-session combination (e.g., "I SEMESTER BCA CBCS" for session SE19) and contains parameters governing result computation including passing percentages (PASSPERCENTAGE, THEOPASSPERCENTAGE, PRACPASSPERCENTAGE), grace mark rules (MAXGRACE, GRACEPERSUBJECT), subject counts (MINSUBJECT, MAXSUBJECT), total marks/credits, and processing status fields (TOTAL, TOTAL_PROCESSED, STARTTIME, ENDTIME). Join to this table when you need to retrieve result processing rules, exam session metadata (MAINHEADER, SUBHEADER, PUBLICATIONDATE), or to link student results back to their course/semester configuration via TRCOURSECODE.

tables.UNI_SYSTEM_IGU.STUDENTAPPLICANTDATA: This table stores student applicant profile data for a university system, with one row per applicant keyed by STUDENTCODE. Each row contains comprehensive demographic and personal information including student name (STUDENTFNAME, STUDENTMNAME, STUDENTLNAME), gender (STUDENTSEX), category codes (STUDENTCATEGORY, STUDENTNATIONALITY), parent/guardian details (FATHERSNAME, MOTHERSNAME, along with their contact and address fields), student addresses (permanent and communication), financial information (PARENTAVERAGEINCOMEPERMONTH, FATHERSANUALINCOME), and identification details (STUDENT_PASSPORT_NUMBER, STUDENTVOTERID, STUDENTACCOUNTNO). Use this table when building reports on student demographics, family information, or applicant profiles, joining on STUDENTCODE to link with enrollment, academic, or fee-related tables.
tables.UNI_SYSTEM_IGU.certificate_application: This table stores certificate application requests submitted by students, with one row per application identified by `id` and linked to a student via `studentcode`. Each record tracks the type of certificate requested (`form_type`, e.g., "PROVISIONALCERTIFICATE"), the associated `course_code`, applicable `fees`, payment tracking fields (`payement_status`, `order_id`, `transection_id`), and a unique reference number (`ref_no`). Use this table when reporting on certificate requests, tracking payment status for certificate fees, or joining to student data via `studentcode` to analyze certificate application activity.
tables.UNI_SYSTEM_IGU.exam_form_details: This table stores exam form submissions with one row per student per semester exam cycle, keyed by `id` and linked to students via `studentcode` and `rollno`. Each record captures the form's processing state (`form_status`), exam type (`exam_type`), semester (`semcode`), session (`sesscode`), syllabus version (`syllcode`), student category (`studenttype`), and result status (`result_status`). Use this table when reporting on exam form submissions, tracking form approval workflows, or joining to student tables to identify who has submitted exam forms for a given semester/session.
